text: At an American research station in Antarctica, the men take in [a sled dog chased by a Norwegian helicopter|trigger|an outsider reaches in], and once kennelled it transforms and absorbs the other dogs. They learn it is [an organism that can perfectly imitate any living thing|rules|it wears a familiar face], found near a spacecraft [buried for over a hundred thousand years|origin|old things disturbed]. With the radio smashed and the stored blood destroyed, pilot MacReady takes command, trusting no one and [burning whatever reveals itself|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
